SYNTHETIC STDERR — not captured from a real gemini-cli run.

The host machine uses OAuth (selectedType: oauth-personal) and the GEMINI_API_KEY override
does not disable the OAuth path in gemini-cli 0.37.1. A real auth failure would produce
stderr output similar to:

  Error: API key not valid. Please pass a valid API key. [HTTP 401]
  Status: UNAUTHENTICATED

Phase 5 error taxonomy will validate the real stderr format against a host with
GEMINI_API_KEY configured (no OAuth credentials).
